title: iPhone: get your Costco receipt as a PDF

vo.text: iPhone: get your Costco receipt as a PDF.
On Android? Use costco.ca, and see our Android video.
Tap Account, then Orders and Purchases.
Pick Online or warehouse. PriceBack reads both.
View the receipt, tap Print Receipt, then Share, and Save to Files.
In PriceBack, tap Upload file, and pick the PDF from Recents.
Check the details, then tap Start Tracking.
